download with an unknown language name returns an error

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try {
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.download(java.util.List.of("zzz_definitely_not_a_real_language_xyz"));
        System.out.println(result);
        } catch (TreeSitterLanguagePackRsException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
